data.name: AlAzim
data.gender_notes: AlAzim is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Arabic root 'Azama', meaning 'to rise above' or 'to be exalted'. In Islamic context, it is used to describe Allah or a highly respected person. The name AlAzim carries the meaning “The Exalted One” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose AlAzim usually hope their child will grow to embody the exalted one and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: A name reflecting the greatness and exaltation of Allah or an individual's devotion and reverence.
data.etymology: AlAzim belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “The Exalted One.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of AlAzim total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
